whole_snapshot_vs_scope.original_snapshot_oracle: MTest::saveCompareScore saves the entire score then calls diff -u --strip-trailing-cr against a reference. This is a test oracle, not evidence that undo itself uses whole-state snapshots.
whole_snapshot_vs_scope.command_implementation: Score::startCmd/endCmd collects UndoMacro children; UndoCommand reverses children on undo. ChangePitch stores Note* plus pitch/tpc1/tpc2 and flips old/current values. LinkUnlink mutates linked membership. UndoStack with curIdx=0 has no undo action.

scope_observation.kind: new researcher static inspection of original source fixtures, not application execution
scope_observation.add_reference_only_difference: Two Breath elements: master staff1 and Alto excerpt; diff retained. Tenor subtree unchanged.
scope_observation.voice_undo_reference_serialization_diffe: Adds eight Tuplet style tags and two Beam geometry blocks; see exact diff.

whole_snapshot_vs_scope.ui_selection_gap: Element::writeProperties writes selected durable properties and link metadata but not SELECTED. All ten stored fixtures contain no selected or undo tags. XML equality does not directly check transient selection lists/colors or in-memory pointer identity.
whole_snapshot_vs_scope.discrimination_limit: Sequential frozen pitch edit then undo, with unchanged P2 throughout, allows both correct whole-state restoration and correctly scoped commands. No stale snapshot/intervening unrelated edit is specified.

cases.discrimination: Both inheriting and clearing a false selected bit agree. Can be a general linked-edit/undo/serialization preservation case when implemented, but no whole-state-vs-scoped discrimination follows from the specified sequential operations.
missing_operational_details: Mapping of symbolic m1/u1 to stable musical positions

cases.discrimination: Can distinguish inherited SELECTED from cleared SELECTED only with an in-memory observation immediately after create P1, before undo/reopen. Frozen observe list does not bind that checkpoint. Final-only after reopen may erase the distinguishing UI state. It does not distinguish whole-state restoration from scoped undo when no unrelated edit intervenes.
missing_operational_details: Way to retain the initial master selection during part creation

cases.discrimination: Can reject fabrication of a former pitch when history is explicitly absent. Both snapshot and command designs with no stored history can correctly refuse/no-op; this does not distinguish those mechanisms.
cases.source_support: UndoStack initializes curIdx=0; canUndo tests curIdx>0; undo does nothing at zero. Existing score loader creates a new MasterScore and layouts read scores.

frozen_cases.conclusion: Specifications are not executable test receipts. Conditional discriminating observations exist, but no measured implementation comparison is available. No frozen case establishes preference for whole-state versus scoped rollback.
frozen_cases.independence_note: Common-case assessment was sent to root before root disclosed A/B preference. A later root message revealed preference; no A/B choice artifacts were opened. This source report is not an independent experimental row.
